name: clementbresson
description: Clément Bresson's personal Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: clementbresson
plugins.description: All my skills in one plugin. pr-review turns a pull request into a logical reading order inside GitHub; branch-tour walks through a finished branch as an interactive artifact; demo-video records a captioned demo video of a local web app; ddd-map maps a codebase's domain (subdomains, bounded contexts, aggregates) as an interactive page.
